name: WCB Desert Conservation Program
summary: California state grants for acquisition, restoration and management projects in the Mojave and Colorado Deserts, including riparian and upland restoration, invasive plant control and seed propagation. Pre-applications are taken continuously.

status.quote: The Wildlife Conservation Board accepts pre-applications for acquisition, restoration, and management projects on a continuous basis.

applicant_types.quote: Entities eligible to apply for grant funding under the Desert Conservation Program include: federal and state agencies, local public agencies, tribal entities, and non-profits with 501 (c)(3) tax exempt status.

geography.quote: restore the natural, cultural, and physical resources of the portions of the Mojave and Colorado Deserts region in California

access.quote: The Wildlife Conservation Board accepts pre-applications for acquisition, restoration, and management projects on a continuous basis.

co_finance_required.quote: Cost share is not required but may be beneficial
